# Links

This project demonstrates how a README points to local documentation and external resources while keeping a useful amount of context for anyone reading it.

## Requirements

Go 1.24.

## Installation

```bash
go install github.com/owner/demo@latest
```

## Usage

```bash
demo README.md
```

Read the [guide](docs/guide.md), the [missing page](docs/missing.md), or visit the [website](https://example.com). The [CI status](https://github.com/owner/demo/actions) is public.
